routing_warnings.description: This message changes branding for the separate Civic Canopy RFQ to Blue Mesa Strategies and does not affect the RCP proposal.
The proposed 34-page cap concerns page-limit compliance rather than the full-document layout system.
The request to condense the first-page letter to one page belongs to the independently defined cover-letter format Requirement.
The reported hyperlink testing concerns final-PDF hyperlink integrity and is not verification of the document-layout Requirement.
The page 74 tree-reframing request concerns photo framing rather than the overall layout system.
The successful email submission and recipient confirmation verify the email-ready PDF behavior rather than adding distinct layout verification.
The source separately reports that all hyperlinks were tested and appeared to work; that observation belongs to the hyperlink-integrity Requirement.
The client reports checking every hyperlink and observing that all worked successfully.
The requested resizable modular table style concerns reuse across future proposals rather than integration of the current RFQ tables.
The separate instruction to condense the first-page letter to one page belongs to the cover-letter Requirement.
The decision to leave the reusable modular template for a future project is a lifecycle change for the separate template Requirement.
